review_evidence: TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Exact/KernelCokernelPair.lean: Defines IsKernelCokernelPair structure with universal properties, proves closure under isomorphism, functoriality, self-duality, and equivalence to ShortExact in balanced categories.

TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Graded/Multilinear.lean: Defines PathMultilinear, PathOperation, HomogeneousPathOperation and proves pathOperationEquiv as a linear equivalence between degreewise and total operations.

TauCeti/CategoryTheory/GrothendieckGroup/Abelian.lean: Defines AbelianK0 as ExactK0 of canonical exact structure, proves kernel-cokernel identity [X]-[Y]=[ker f]-[coker f], universal property liftEquiv, and functoriality under exact functors.
TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Grp/Cokernel.lean: Proves isColimitCokernelCoforkOfTorsor — a torsor projection that is effective epi with epi square is the cokernel of its subgroup inclusion.
TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Sites/IsSheafFor.lean: Proves compatible_iff_of_isTerminal — compatibility condition for presheaves over families mapping to a terminal object.
TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Cartan/TypeF4.lean: Provides explicit Bezout certificate typeF4CartanBezout proving row primitivity of the F₄ Cartan matrix.

TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Basic.lean: Defines tensorComponent (contraction against right factor), proves tensorComponent_tmul, tensorComponent_map, tensorComponent_zero, and tensorProduct_rid_rTensor_apply.
TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Kernel.lean: Proves ker_baseChange_of_flat and ker_baseChange_of_surjective — kernels commute with extension of scalars for flat algebras or surjective maps.
TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Closed/Functor.lean: Defines ihomComparison for lax monoidal functors, proves characteristic equations (ev, coev), naturality, and invertibility criteria.

TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Products/Basic.lean: Provides componentwise HasZeroMorphisms, EssentiallySmall, HasZeroObject instances for product categories, and proves pushout/pullback squares are detected componentwise.
TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Groupoid/SingleObj.lean: Proves singleObjEquivalence — a connected groupoid is equivalent to the one-object category of its vertex group.
TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/CrossProduct.lean: Proves mulVec_cross_add_cross_mulVec and its trace-zero specialization — matrix action on cross product as derivation.
TauCeti/CategoryTheory/GrothendieckGroup/Exact.lean: Defines ExactK0 via PresentedK0, proves universal property, biadditive invariants, functoriality, and comparison maps (ofLE, fromSplit).

TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/Diagonalization.lean: Proves orthogonal basis existence iff symmetric form is zero or not alternating (all characteristics), orthonormal basis over square fields, and symplectic/orthonormal dichotomy.

TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Preadditive/Indecomposable.lean: Proves indecomposability criteria — trivial idempotents, local endomorphism ring, brick criterion; also isoBiprodOfRetracts and isIso_of_isIso_comp.

TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/ExteriorAlgebra/Subspace.lean: Proves ι_mul_exteriorAlgebra_eq_zero_iff (subspace recovery from top exterior product), map_span_exteriorAlgebra_eq_iff (automorphism stabilization equivalence).
TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/ClassicalTypeD.lean: Constructs classical Dₙ roots (±e_a±e_b), Bourbaki simple roots, coordinates, Gram matrix = CartanMatrix.D, linear independence, reflections.
TauCeti/CategoryTheory/Shift/Prod.lean: Constructs componentwise shift on product categories, proves additive shift functors, CommShift instances for projections, products, and zero sections.
